name: HTTP Fetch
author: V-Agent
description: Lets the AI agent fetch any public URL (GET) and read the response — documentation pages, REST APIs, raw files. Works with every provider, including offline-configured ones.

name: TODO Scanner
author: V-Agent
description: Scans the whole workspace for TODO / FIXME / HACK / XXX comments and gives the AI a structured list with file and line numbers. Ask "what's left to do in this project?".

name: Serial Tools
author: V-Agent
description: Robotics helper: list serial ports and send/receive a line over serial (Arduino, Pico, ESP32…) straight from the AI chat. Sending requires pyserial (pip install pyserial); port listing works out of the box.
